finding.text: The Count switch does not survive a reload (requirement 5). Its checkbox flips the class-level row (`Badge.enable/disable`), which `PluginEntry.js:75` writes to `Plugin.store`, an in-memory `Map` (`Plugin.js:123`). `save()` only posts `demo.overrides`, which never holds Count. So a reload brings Count back on. The readme's "Watch out" admits the switch is class-level but not that it is lost. Either save Count's state in the same line (for example `{"overrides": …, "sub": {"Badge.Count": false}}`) or write the gap as a `log` line for live-page (per-instance sub-plugin overrides) and say in the readme that this one switch doesn't persist.

Below ~700px the panel stacks **above** the box, not under it (brief: "the panel stacks under the box"). See shots/…-plugins/400.png: the checkbox card comes first and "Live result" second. Also, the wrap comes from `flex: 1 1 16em` ×2, so it happens near 530px, not 700px. Put the box first in source order (or `order`) and set the breakpoint on purpose.

The part-link card on /live/demos/ is not in the diff. It was written straight to the main tree's `public/live/demos/page.jsonl` (line 29, by the item tool), and it points at `./plugins/`, a folder that only exists on `worktree/plugins-mvp`. Until the merge, the main site shows a link that 404s. In the worktree shot (…-live-demos/1200.png), "Plugins" only appears through the automatic PAGES list. Say this in the task log, so the merger knows the card is already live and must not be added twice.

A fresh agent could not tell from the task folder alone that the Count limit (finding 1) and the main-tree card (finding 3) are open. `task.jsonl` has one log line saying "Nothing left undone against the brief". Add both as log lines.
`files.jsonl` commits a temp-file entry and its matching `gone` line (`DemoPage.test.mjs.tmp.48704…`). That is noise in an index.
The committed `page.jsonl` holds two lines from the minion's headless round trip, stamped `"by":"owner"`. The final state is `{}` so it does no harm, but the owner never made those switches.
At 400 the code block wraps its comments mid-phrase ("// this / instance only", shots/…-plugins/400.png, band 5). Shorter comments, or one comment line above each call, would keep each line whole.

At 1200 and above, the demo row sits in the standard ~600px column with lots of empty space (`layout.json` empty 0.84 at 1200 and 3440; the `flex` band is `big_empty: true` at both). The "Live result" box is narrow, so `Wide` ("full width") only widens it to its half column, a small change. No shot shows Wide on.
A console 404 appears at every width (`layout.json` errors). The resource isn't named; worth one check.
The test sets `count_row.up = badge_row` by hand to make `active` read false. That tests a patched state, not the real draw path.
